description: Defines the OperationData class for managing scaffold operation parameters within Drupal's Composer plugin, including normalization and access methods for operation metadata.

classes.name: OperationData
classes.description: Class for handling parameter data for scaffold operations, including normalization and accessors for operation metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes OperationData with destination path and raw data, normalizing metadata.

methods.name: hasPath
methods.description: Checks if a path is set in the data.

methods.name: overwrite
methods.description: Indicates if overwrite mode is enabled.

methods.name: forceAppend
methods.description: Indicates if 'force-append' mode is set or default.

methods.name: hasPrepend
methods.description: Checks if a prepend path exists.

methods.name: hasAppend
methods.description: Checks if an append path exists.

methods.name: normalizeScaffoldMetadata
methods.description: Normalizes metadata by converting literals into arrays with default values.

methods.name: convertScaffoldMetadata
methods.description: Converts metadata to array form, handling booleans and strings, and setting mode based on paths.
